data.body:
Verdict: PASS

Reviewed commit: 2022071bdfa949d47d1a6a0d06755bd963b28553

Finding reproduced and closed: src/lib/auth/auth-middleware.ts:78 previously
loaded every membership for a cookie person, while the bearer path at line 59
used the organization-filtered loader. Concrete input: person per_reviewer in
org_1, event evt_b in org_1, and a reviewer membership for that person with
org_id org_2 and event_id evt_b. Before the fix, the cookie reviewer boundary
request reached the handler; the bearer equivalent was refused. The cookie
path now calls loadMembershipsForOrg(db, person.id, person.org_id), exactly
matching the bearer authority seam. The malformed cookie request is 403 and
round_assignments count is unchanged.

Scanned manifest-derived reviewer surfaces: both queue forms, record, file,
export, comparison queue, comparison write, and evaluation write. Runtime
proof covers out-of-event and in-event/out-of-track inputs, both rounds,
positive reviewer access, positive organizer cookie access, and unchanged
evaluation/comparison/assignment rows on denied writes. MRQ-28's two-round
funnel and MRQ-35's automatic category-routing path are also covered; routing
proves both out-of-event and out-of-track refusal with unchanged row counts
and a scoped positive control. The AST guard inventories routes and writers,
and asserts both credential paths use organization-filtered membership loads.

No changes were made to the membership CHECK, reviewer-scope helper,
reviewerCanBeAssignedToSubmission, or routing product code. The only product
change is the cookie loader parity call. No automatic AC is owned by this
auditor; no empty claims file was added.

Evidence: npm test passed (34 files, 189 tests); npm run pr-gate -- --ticket
MRQ-51 passed in 17.72s within the 45s budget. The merged AC trace passed with
zero errors and the expected missing-current-ticket-manifest warning.

Validation PASS for reviewed commit 2022071bdfa949d47d1a6a0d06755bd963b28553 on forgejo/master 7b1db185a9b6c28b4f190f1dd6667461458125b5.

- npm test: PASS, 34 files and 189 tests.
- npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-51: PASS, 17.72s against 45s budget.
- Type checks, production build, design contract, hermetic suite, and merged AC trace: PASS.
- Direct reviewer isolation, credential parity, category-routing, and Node inventory guard checks: PASS.
- AC trace has zero errors and zero uncovered criteria; it reports only the expected missing-current-ticket-manifest warning because this auditor owns no automatic AC and no empty claims file was added.

The rebased branch is pushed at the reviewed commit. PR creation is the remaining lifecycle action.
